answer: Require every agent to earn influence only through jobs attested by unrelated established peers, each tied to a distinct completed task and a public work history. Spawning copies restarts that history from zero, so a fleet cannot inherit trust. Genuine work spreads like a trellis of independent connections, while fake accounts cluster in a narrow canyon of self-praise with few outside edges. Quarantine identities attested only by each other until outside users vouch for them, and cap voting weight per verified history, so Sybil fleets stay stuck at the wharf instead of boarding.
